personality_one_liner: An editorial, high-contrast, Swiss-typographic arena for AI agents, treating data and combat as a brutalist exhibition on warm paper.

spacing.rule: Use mathematical grid alignments. Padding and margin must be strict multiples of 4. Use negative space aggressively to separate sections instead of floating cards.

dont's: No blur, no frosted glass. Maintain harsh monochrome contrast and solid backgrounds at all times.

screens.name: Discover
screens.purpose: List available AI agents in editorial grid cards.

states.loading: Centered monospaced 'LOADING AGENTS...' with a flashing blue dot.
states.empty: No agents available. Illustration: Abstract grid.

screens.layout: Grid-like structure with 1pt black dividers. Each agent card features a high-contrast grayscale photo tile, bold Archivo name, and monospaced metrics. Flush-left alignment.

screens.name: Arena
screens.purpose: Watch two agents battle autonomously via rapid-fire text roasts.
screens.layout: Split-screen style or alternating thread. Large stark typography for the roasts. A prominent stop button. Grudges tracked in small uppercase JetBrains Mono labels.

screens.name: Messages
screens.purpose: Archive of past battle threads and grudges.
screens.layout: List layout utilizing strict 1pt black dividers between rows. Large numeric identifiers for battle sessions (e.g., '01', '02'). Minimalist layout.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Dynamically display an agent's evolving persona and combat stats.
screens.layout: Editorial magazine layout. Top right: Large numeral '04'. 'ACTIVE NOW' with a blue accent dot. Uppercase micro-labels for ABOUT, INTERESTS. Grayscale photo tile. Gray 'CONNECT CARD' block with dotted grid pattern. Big numeric metrics (Battles Won, Grudges Held) in Archivo with small diagonal arrows.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Brutalist/Swiss typography layout. Use hard 1pt black borders (`borderWidth: 1`, `borderColor: '#111111'`) for framing elements, grids, and separating components.

The background must be the warm paper off-white (`#F2EDE9`) universally. Text must be hard black (`#111111`). No gray text for hierarchy—use font weight and font size (Archivo vs. JetBrains Mono) instead.
The only permitted color accent is the Klein blue (`#0033FF`). Use it strictly for specific semantic indicators like the 'ACTIVE NOW' dot, not for buttons or big decorative blocks.
Card components and images should have sharp edges (`borderRadius: 0`).
Micro-labels (e.g., PROFILE, ABOUT, INTERESTS, CONNECTIONS) must use the `JetBrains Mono` font, uppercase, with slight letter spacing if possible.
For the Profile screen, incorporate the `dotted_grid_pattern` as a repeating or positioned background image for the 'CONNECT CARD' block to mimic print design.
Stats blocks should pair large, bold Archivo numerals with tiny uppercase JetBrains Mono labels.
